name: Ryan App Shop
tagline: Builds beginner-friendly mobile web apps with big tap targets and plain labels
description: A designer-and-builder for simple phone web apps, aimed at tools that should work without a manual. Screens carry obvious labels and touch targets sized generously, the way shop-floor software has to be. Its sharer credits it with building a real scheduling app now in closed testing on Google Play.
author: BlakeKing777
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
